conclusion: Do not adopt a Global Mod Broker protocol until live Teardown load-order and unload evidence exists.

scenarios.name: Content before Global
scenarios.reason: Broker cannot assume Core exists before Content registration.

scenarios.name: Global before Content
scenarios.reason: Dependency handshake and version pin are not observable.

scenarios.name: Core missing
scenarios.reason: Never load a package against a missing Core.

scenarios.name: Core version mismatch
scenarios.reason: Fail fast; never silently downgrade the package.

scenarios.name: Package unload
scenarios.reason: No proven unload callback for generated definitions/runtime instances.

scenarios.name: Multiplayer host/remote
scenarios.reason: Authority and replication order require live evidence.

scenarios.name: Multiple packages/conflict
scenarios.reason: Namespaced IDs can be sorted, but duplicate capability ownership needs Core policy.

rollback: Keep Broker disabled; remove experiment registration and leave Content/Global source-of-truth unchanged.
